main_measure.name: clustered-by-day t of the slope of drift-adjusted 5-bar return on forecast (grid bars, forecast < 0)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= +2 with supporting check passing; reject if t <= -2; else inconclusive; at least 100 grid cases with forecast < 0

supporting_check.name: mean drift-adjusted 5-bar return on grid bars with forecast <= -10 is below 0

decided_by: The slope's t lies between -2 and +2 (inconclusive rule).
reading: Grid cases are grid bars (positions 0,5,10,... per window) with a 5-bar forward return inside the window, the normal drift is each coin's mean 5-bar return over all its grid bars in all windows, 'cases of one day together' is a day-clustered (CR1) OLS slope t, the choppy situation is the recorded default regime 'unknown', and a missing minimum count gives 'not observable' as the workflow requires.
